messages:
maria (docs): Quick sync: we need a concise deprecation playbook for v1 -> v2 and a small migration appendix for model swaps. Goal: low-friction guidance + example diffs. Thoughts?

kevin (eng-runtime): Agreed. Need to publish alias mapping and note fallback semantics. Also call out that some compact models change embedding dim (e.g., rwd-embed-compact: 1536 -> 1024).

tony (sdk): Heads up: JS/TS/Python SDKs will rename `stream` to `streaming` and change the preferred entrypoint from `generate` to `responses.create`. We should update all Quickstarts and include one-line migrations.

sasha (product): Can we offer a short grace window on Dedicated deployments (60-90 days) where we enable a compatibility flag? Customers will ask.

jess (techwriter): I'll draft the migration appendix. Planned sections: migration checklist, snippet diffs, alias table, support KB copy, known incompatibilities. Need canonical snippet style — prefer full `responses.create` call?

maria (docs): Yes, canonical = `responses.create`. Include an "old -> new" callout for each snippet. Keep examples minimal. Also add a tiny smoke test command for reviewers.

kevin (eng-runtime): I'll upload the alias CSV and a short test matrix showing which model maps to which fallback variant under load. Also adding unit tests for alias resolution.

lisa (pm): I'll draft customer comms timeline and create support canned responses. Proposed notify date: 2026-05-10; final sunset: 2026-07-09.

docs-bot: PR 4721 opened by jess: docs/migration/v1-to-v2-playbook-draft.md — https://git.redwood/PR/4721

ton y (sdk): Attached gists for snippet replacements. Example migration to include in the appendix:
```
# old (python)
resp = client.generate(model="rwd-chat-1", stream=True, input="hi")

# new (python)
resp = client.responses.create(model="rwd-chat-1", streaming=True, input="hi")
```

jess (techwriter): Draft PR link above. Please comment inline on exact code blocks to change. I'll also add a small glossary for "alias", "fallback", and "compatibility flag".

kevin (eng-runtime): Note for docs: embedding dims change for `rwd-embed-compact`. Add a migration note and a short conversion example for users who normalize dims client-side.

sasha (product): Confirming enterprise ask: I'll check feasibility of the Dedicated compatibility flag and report by EOD tomorrow. If not possible, we'll add explicit migration steps in the enterprise notice.

maria (docs): Action items: jess finish draft by Tue EOD; tony prep SDK PRs and changelog entries; kevin attach alias map and test summary; lisa prepare support KB stub; sasha confirm Dedicated window.

lisa (pm): I'll also schedule a short internal beta with selected customers to surface edge cases.

tony (sdk): One more small item: update changelogs to highlight the param rename and list example one-liners for shell/curl replacements.

jess (techwriter): Quick reviewer checklist I will add: run smoke curl, verify snippet compiles in TS/py, check embedding dims table, confirm all links valid.

maria (docs): Smoke test suggestion to include in PR:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","input":"hello"}'
```

kevin (eng-runtime): Pushing a small test harness for staging alias seeding. Will link the infra ticket in the PR.

sasha (product): Dates locked for now. If anything changes we escalate.

maria (docs): Great — thanks all. Please add any PR links here as you create them. :thumbsup:
